text: Entry Requirements 1.Non-Chinese citizen with valid foreign passport; 2.Age under 25; 3.In good physical and mental health (Note:BDS program does not admit left-handed students); 4.Qualified with a high school degree or above or K12 grade(10+2) or equivalent academic ability; English, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology courses have passed the graduation exams of the student's country (at least B/70).
